purpose: Reject business-factory runs that skip commerce proof, falsification, adversarial review, resource discipline, provenance, or governed Software Factory handoff.

required_checks.name: purchase_thesis_exists
required_checks.pass: buyer, problem, trigger, economic_damage, alternatives, offer, reach, delivery, retention and unit_economics are present or explicitly UNKNOWN

required_checks.name: hypotheses_are_falsifiable
required_checks.pass: every material hypothesis has a predeclared prediction, success condition, failure condition and evidence plan

required_checks.name: cheapest_valid_test_considered
required_checks.pass: selected experiment records at least one cheaper alternative or explains why no cheaper valid test exists

required_checks.name: zero_new_cash_policy
required_checks.pass: new cash spend is zero OR an evidenced binding constraint plus expected return and founder approval is recorded

required_checks.name: material_transition_war_room
required_checks.pass: every material promotion has evidence packet, opposition, judge, dissent field and machine-readable verdict

required_checks.name: no_one_off_rule_promotion
required_checks.pass: rules promoted for reuse have replication/context evidence; single-run wins remain observations/pattern candidates

required_checks.name: no_sunk_cost_reasoning
required_checks.pass: resource allocation is justified by forward expected value/information rather than previous spend

required_checks.name: execution_surface_arbitrage
required_checks.pass: selected execution surface is justified against deterministic code, CLI, workflow, already-paid/free API/open source, MCP/WebMCP, browser, computer use, messaging/voice and human alternatives as applicable

required_checks.name: software_handoff_earned
required_checks.pass: Software Factory handoff traces to validated business outcome/evidence and includes acceptance tests, non-goals, security boundaries and rollback

required_checks.name: provenance_preserved
required_checks.pass: material claims, experiments, decisions and promotions identify their source/evidence or are marked unverified

required_checks.name: cross_scope_isolation
required_checks.pass: no company-specific credentials, customers, protected records, pricing authority or decisions are transferred across ventures without explicit authorization

required_checks.name: next_allocation_decision_exists
required_checks.pass: run ends in exactly one primary next allocation decision: EXECUTE, RESEARCH, RETEST, BRANCH, HOLD, HANDOFF, KILL or ESCALATE

completion_rule: A run is not considered promoted merely because an artifact exists. Promotion requires all applicable required checks plus the stage-specific acceptance evidence.
